structuredReview.summary: The proposed pin and coordinated workflow edits are feasible, but the planned acceptance and verification do not establish that the selected remote commit is reachable or actually provides the stated 0.0.24 behavior. Add concrete checks for those two claims before implementation is considered verified.

findings.title: Reachability of the selected action commit is not verified
findings.trigger: The four workflows are updated to use 56134240116afe7a3c6da92245de1adc04b08a64, but that commit is not available to GitHub Actions remote uses resolution.
findings.impact: Reusable workflow runs fail when GitHub cannot resolve the action reference, despite local contract tests passing.
findings.fix: Add a verification step that confirms the selected SHA is reachable from the remote repository and can be resolved as an action ref; require it to pass before merging.

findings.title: Acceptance does not prove the selected pin has the claimed sign-in floor
findings.trigger: The workflows all use the specified SHA, but that commit does not contain the login-floor change or its behavior differs from the plan's claim.
findings.impact: Callers selecting 0.0.23 may still fail sign-in, or the 0.0.24 floor may not be enforced, while all named acceptance checks pass.
findings.fix: Add a concrete verification of the pinned commit's action.yml floor and tests or a focused integration check showing 0.0.23 installs signed out and 0.0.24 signs in.

findings.title: Formatting gate covers only one changed workflow
findings.trigger: Formatting issues are introduced in cloudflare-preview.yml, cloudflare-production.yml, webpresso-security.yml, or README.md while the listed gate checks only changesets-release.yml.
findings.impact: The stated formatting verification can pass while other changed files fail the formatter.
findings.fix: Run wp format --check against every changed file, matching the task instruction and acceptance criterion.

findings.title: No failure-path check is specified for an unavailable wp version
findings.trigger: A caller selects a version below the installable archive range or an unavailable version after the pin change.
findings.impact: The plan's verification exercises only the full contract suite and formatting; it may miss a regression in the install failure path while establishing the new sign-in behavior.
findings.fix: Add or identify a contract case asserting unavailable versions still fail with the intended exit behavior, or narrow the stated behavioral claim to the tested cases.
